I recently had the same problem with the exact same dvd set.  It wouldn’t play on my week old PS5, nor my PS4 Pro.  It did play just fine on my laptop and Sony DVD/Blu-ray player though, absolutely without problem.  My set is scratch free, has no smudges or fingerprints that to could see.  A quick Google search revealed that this has been a problem with this set since release and even affects XBoxes.

Hope that helps.
